room_rent.note: Up to SI; no room rent sub-limit mentioned for Premiere Plan

icu.note: No ICU sub-limit specified; covered up to SI

copayment.display: None (age-based co-pay if first entry at 60+)
copayment.note: No mandatory co-pay for entry below 60. 20% for entry age 60-64, 25% for 65-69, 30% for 70-74, 40% for 75+ (first-time entrants only)

sub_limits.display: Cataract capped at 10% of SI, max ₹1L/eye; maternity sub-limits
sub_limits.note: Cataract: 10% of SI/eye, max ₹1L/eye. Maternity: normal ₹40,000-₹50,000; LSCS ₹60,000-₹1,00,000 depending on SI. Domiciliary 10% of SI. Emergency evacuation 5% of SI. OPD limit applies.

deductible.note: Voluntary deductible available as optional; base has none

ped_waiting.note: 50% liability in 3rd year, 100% from 4th year onwards

specific_disease_waiting.display: 24 months (most listed conditions); 36 months for joint replacement/organ transplant

maternity.display: Covered (36mo wait for self / 24mo for spouse)
maternity.note: Normal delivery ₹40,000-₹50,000; LSCS ₹60,000-₹1,00,000 (varies by SI). Pre-natal 90 days & post-natal 45 days hospitalisation covered. Newborn baby cover + vaccination up to ₹5,000 included.

cumulative_bonus.note: 50% of SI added per claim-free year; max 100% of base SI. OPD claims (Benefit 13) do not affect bonus.

restoration.note: Triggered only after full SI + cumulative bonus exhausted. Cannot be used for same illness already claimed or maternity.

domiciliary.note: Several conditions excluded; minimum 3-day treatment required

ayush.note: Inpatient only under Benefit 17; OPD allopathic covered under Benefit 13

ambulance.note: Actual expenses for network hospitalisation; ₹5,000 cap for non-network

consumables.note: Consumables listed in Annexure III excluded

global_cover.note: Benefit 18: covers 8 specific major procedures abroad (e.g. CABG, organ transplant, bone marrow transplant) after 36 months continuous Premiere Plan coverage. Reimbursement in INR only. 15-day prior notice required.

notable_exclusions: Stem cell storage, external congenital anomaly, STDs (non-HIV), hormone replacement therapy, non-prescribed drugs, refractive error <7.5D, infertility/ART
optional_riders: Voluntary deductible (discount on premium); child vaccination benefit (₹5,000/yr up to age 12) inbuilt
